name: Idaho DOPL HVAC Board License Search

agency.name: Idaho Division of Occupational and Professional Licenses

updateFrequency: unknown; verify against DOPL online services before relying on freshness assumptions
licenseTypesIncluded: Idaho HVAC Board contractor, specialty contractor, journeyman, specialty journeyman, apprentice, and related HVAC license classes exposed by DOPL online services
knownExclusions: This source is limited to Idaho HVAC Board records and does not represent contractor registration, electrical, plumbing, public works, asbestos, local permits, or business-registration records.
Sheet-metal coverage is limited to work that falls within HVAC or mechanical code/licensing context; no standalone statewide sheet-metal contractor source has been confirmed.
The lookup is hosted in DOPL online services; adapter work must review public search controls before automation.
rateLimitNotes: No adapter is implemented. Do not automate DOPL online-services pages unless official terms, result limits, and technical controls are reviewed.
publicRecordsNotes: Official lookup metadata only. Absence from this source is not proof that an HVAC, mechanical, sheet-metal, permit, local authorization, or related contractor registration record does not exist elsewhere.
officialLookupReviewNotes: The official Idaho HVAC Board page links a DOPL online-services license search for HVAC records.
officialBulkDownloadNotes: No official stable bulk download has been confirmed for Idaho HVAC licenses in this phase.
researchNotes: Keep this source separate from DOPL contractor registration because HVAC contractor and specialty credentials are regulated through a distinct DOPL board.
verificationCaveats: This source covers Idaho HVAC Board records, not every Idaho mechanical, sheet-metal, local permit, or business-registration record.
No matching record means no match in this source at the checked time, not proof that an authorization does not exist elsewhere.
verificationNotes: No supported sync or verification adapter is exposed while official lookup behavior and allowed automation remain under review.
maintainerNotes: Future adapter research should distinguish HVAC contractor, specialty contractor, journeyman, specialty journeyman, and permit-related records.

researchEvidence.note: Official Idaho HVAC Board page reviewed; it links DOPL online-services license search and lists HVAC contractor, specialty contractor, journeyman, specialty journeyman, and apprentice fee classes.

blocker.summary: The official path is lookup-oriented and no stable, documented machine-readable interface has been adapter-reviewed with offline fixtures.
